title: Chairman Jing Aarons received Freedom of the City of London the origin which dates back to the 14th Century
summary: On 1st September 2021, Jing Aarons, Chairman of Anglo Asia Education Foundation received the award with a presentation ceremony at Chamberlain’s Court London’s Guildhall...
body:
On 1st September 2021, Jing Aarons, Chairman of Anglo Asia Education Foundation received the award with a presentation ceremony at Chamberlain’s Court London’s Guildhall before the Aldermen, Common Councillors, Aarons’ family members and invited guests. Jing read the ‘Declaration of a Freeman’ and signed the Freeman’s Declaration Book.


The award results from the outstanding efforts of Jing and her family in dedicating their time to charitable work in education in both the UK and Asia and fostering relations between students and teachers from both countries.


Famous Freeman of City of London include

  • Florence Nightingale
  • Stephen Hawking
  • Princess Diana
